columns.name: activity_year_and_month
columns.api_description: The month, e.g. 2026-08.

columns.name: monthly_active_learners
columns.api_description: Learners who did course work this month: watched a video, attempted a problem, posted in a discussion, used the chatbot or moved through course pages. Only activity in an enrollment that is still active counts. Enrolling or earning a certificate alone doesn't count. Withheld when too few learners are in the group to report without identifying them.

columns.name: new_enrollments
columns.api_description: Course enrollments made this month that are still active. A learner who enrolled in six courses counts six times. Withheld when the learner count it is based on is withheld.

columns.name: enrolling_learners
columns.api_description: Learners with at least one course enrollment made this month that is still active. Withheld when too few learners are in the group to report without identifying them.

columns.name: certificates_earned
columns.api_description: Certificates earned this month. A learner who earned two counts twice. Withheld when the learner count it is based on is withheld.

columns.name: certified_learners
columns.api_description: Deprecated: use newly_certified_learners, which this always equals.

columns.name: newly_certified_learners
columns.api_description: Learners who earned at least one certificate this month. Withheld when too few learners are in the group to report without identifying them.

columns.name: total_videos_watched
columns.api_description: Videos watched this month. A video counts once for each day a learner plays it, so replaying it the same day doesn't add to the total. Withheld when the learner count it is based on is withheld.

columns.name: video_watchers
columns.api_description: Learners who watched at least one video this month. Only activity in an enrollment that is still active counts. Withheld when too few learners are in the group to report without identifying them.

columns.name: total_problems_attempted
columns.api_description: Problems attempted this month. A problem counts once for each day a learner submits an answer to it, so resubmitting it the same day doesn't add to the total. Withheld when the learner count it is based on is withheld.

columns.name: problem_attempters
columns.api_description: Learners who attempted at least one problem this month. Only activity in an enrollment that is still active counts. Withheld when too few learners are in the group to report without identifying them.

columns.name: total_chatbot_interactions
columns.api_description: Chatbot interactions this month. Withheld when the learner count it is based on is withheld.

columns.name: chatbot_users
columns.api_description: Learners who used the chatbot this month. Only activity in an enrollment that is still active counts. Withheld when too few learners are in the group to report without identifying them.

columns.name: contributing_learners
columns.api_description: Learners who did course work, enrolled or earned a certificate this month.
